editions.serialAsPrinted: No range on the cover or ID page. Main break: use before S/N 9646801 / use S/N 9646801 and after (frame, hood, steering bracket, front axle, engine mounting, belts/pulleys, brake, PTO, decals). The C16767 modification kit (p27) prints 'used prior to S/N 9646800'. Minor breaks: 9654190 (idler arm), 9654440 (choke/throttle control, 107 instrument panel decal), 9654460 (PTO rear rod, engaging lever), 9655494 (ignition switch), 9655647 (electrical system, PTO decal).

validation.method: Scan (no text layer, 200-dpi 1-bit spreads): tables read by eye from 2 pages per image at 0.58x, doubtful cells zoomed at full resolution (REF/REQ'D strips for register checks); tesseract only as a draft.
validation.refContinuity: All 35 sections continuous from 1 with no gaps. 12 rows printed without a ref number are kept and flagged (fuel decals x2, 107 starting-caution decal, 2 differential sub-items 'see Ref. 16/21', starter C15989 header row, ignition kit contents key + decal, late-system ignition key, J-wire clip, head lamp kit, head lamp assembly). Duplicate refs are variants (serial, model, oversize) as printed.
validation.quantities: All rows have a qty except fuel ref 27 (REQ'D covered by a scan blot) and PTO ref 16 (no REQ'D printed); 2 rows are UAR. Engine ref 11 REQ'D is smudged by a handwritten mark (read as 1, flagged). The 117 early belts page (p29) prints REQ'D slightly below the rows: mapped in sequence, counts equal, 20 rows flagged 'inferred qty'. Transmission fan (p39 ref 10) prints 5, kept.
validation.numericalIndex: Index (printed pp60-65, ~930 entries) compared column by column in sort order against the transcription, both directions. Three reading fixes came from it (breaker ref 2 = C15906, differential ref 32 = F53650, late electrical ref 12 = C17807; each confirmed by zoom). Remaining differences, table kept: (1) C10450 (p47 ref 60) is indexed as G 10450; (2) breaker p51: the table prints 129-5 (ref 9) and 129-15 (ref 11), the index lists 129-15 at 51/9 and C16056 at 51/11; (3) the index lists all 14 Engine Mounting Plate parts at page 15 as well as page 7 (page 15 is the carburetor), which also puts C16752 at 15/4; (4) rows shared by both electrical-system tables (same page and ref) are indexed once.
validation.partNoForms: Case letter prefixes closed up (C15847, A30881, F53650, L32763, T25070, D59949, O5999AB); hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (113-111). Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted (including the '*' footnote marks on p9). Truncated codes kept as printed and flagged: 92-4, 26-636 (index prints the same); bare '35012' (no prefix, index agrees).
